title: Visible Repair / Scar Preserves Transformation
observed_structure: an object or surface is damaged through a known event
repair restores function without erasing the break
later use depends on both restoration and retained scar
cinematic_affordances: repair process shown through precise action
scar retained in close and wide continuity
light or sound revealing the repaired seam on recurrence
cultural_scope: general repair structure; specific repair traditions require their own provenance
transferable_structure: function returns through repair while visible evidence of rupture continues to shape later use
non_transferable_surface: borrowing culturally specific repair aesthetics or ceremonial meanings without provenance
